name: semteams-full-stack-e2e
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq && curl -fsSL https://taskfile.dev/install.sh | sudo sh -s -- -d -b /usr/local/bin ${TASK_VERSION} && npx -y playwright@${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION} install --with-deps chromium

semteams.notes: agentic-e2e stack workload — spawns sibling testcontainers. Docker-outside-of-docker required (host socket mounted) — docker-socket privilege requires admission-reviewer signoff per chain. Shorter TTL (12h) than backend/UI because e2e stacks pull more images and are more sensitive to upstream drift.
